sents.zh: 我家有一只小猫，它的名字叫小白。
sents.en: We have a little cat at home called Little White.

sents.zh: 它是去年来我家的，那时候它还很小。
sents.en: It came to us last year, when it was still very small.

sents.zh: 它都是白的，只有眼是黑的。
sents.en: It is white all over, with only its eyes black.

sents.zh: 每天早上，它都会叫我起床。
sents.en: Every morning it wakes me up.

sents.zh: 如果我不起来，它就坐在我的头上面看着我。
sents.en: If I do not get up, it sits above my head and watches me.

sents.zh: 我起来以后，第一件事就是给它吃的。
sents.en: After I get up, the first thing I do is feed it.

sents.zh: 它最喜欢吃鱼，其他的东西吃得不多。
sents.en: It likes fish best, and does not eat much else.

sents.zh: 吃完以后，它会玩一玩球。
sents.en: After eating it plays with a ball for a bit.

sents.zh: 有时候它跳到我的书上面睡觉。
sents.en: Sometimes it jumps onto my books and goes to sleep.

sents.zh: 因为它在上面，所以我不能看书。
sents.en: Because it is on them, I cannot read.

sents.zh: 我要去学校的时候，它就在门口看着我。
sents.en: When I leave for school it watches me from the door.

sents.zh: 下午我回家，它会跑过来叫一声。
sents.en: When I come home in the afternoon it runs over and gives a cry.

sents.zh: 虽然它不会说话，但是我知道它很高兴。
sents.en: Although it cannot speak, I know it is glad.

sents.zh: 晚上它在我的床边睡，一动也不动。
sents.en: At night it sleeps by my bed, without stirring.

sents.zh: 我很爱我的小猫，它是我最好的朋友。
sents.en: I love my little cat; it is my best friend.
